title: Analysis and numerical simulation of a spatio-temporal Ricker-type model for the control of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes with Sterile Insect Techniques
summary: Sterile Insect Technique (SIT) is widely regarded as a promising, environmentally friendly and chemical-free strategy for the prevention and control of dengue and other vector-borne diseases. In this paper, we develop and analyze a spatio-temporal reaction-diffusion model describing the dynamics of three mosquito subpopulations involved in SIT-based biological control of Aedes aegypti mosquitoes.
